messages:
rachel_support: Maestro Retail just flagged invoice #INV-2025-451 (charge ch_3K7a9f) — their AP says the 'Purchase Reference' field is blank. They can't post-payment without a PO on the invoice. Need reissue/credit guidance, ticket 98765.

mike_billing: can you paste the invoice id and payment id? is the payment settled? we generally do credit note + reissue for post-payment PO additions. :thinking: 

rachel_support: INV-2025-451, payment ch_3K7a9f settled 2025-07-27T14:12Z. Customer AP email ap@maestro-retail.com. They require the PO 'PO-7721' to be on the invoice header.

sre-bot: Payment ch_3K7a9f confirmed by ledger service at 2025-07-27T14:12:02Z. Charge status: succeeded.

dan_engineer: if we credit and reissue, note: platform doesn't auto-reattach a settled charge to a new invoice. allocation is manual in ledger. any preference from customer — refund + re-pay vs reapply?

jordan_account_manager: cc @mike_billing @rachel_support — customer wants reissued invoice with PO. Proposed path:
1) issue credit note for INV-2025-451
2) create reissued invoice INV-2025-451-R1 with Purchase Reference = PO-7721
3) manually allocate payment ch_3K7a9f to the new invoice in ledger
4) send updated PDF to ap@maestro-retail.com and confirm acceptance

mike_billing: agreed. i'll create the credit note. rachel, confirm line items/tax so reissue matches totals exactly.

rachel_support: lines same — 3 x Premium seats @ $500 = $1500, VAT 20% = $300, total $1800. USD. no discounts.

mike_billing: creating credit via API now:
```
POST /v1/credits
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2025-451",
  "reason": "Add missing purchase reference per AP request",
  "refund": false
}
```

mike_billing: credit created: CN-2025-109 for $1800. marking original invoice as void for external reporting. :white_check_mark: 

rachel_support: when reissuing make sure invoice header shows 'Purchase Reference: PO-7721' and filename/subject includes INV-2025-451-R1 so AP can match.

mike_billing: creating reissued invoice with metadata:
```
POST /v1/invoices
{
  "reference": "INV-2025-451-R1",
  "lines": ["3 x Premium seats @ $500"],
  "metadata": {"purchase_reference": "PO-7721"},
  "related_credit": "CN-2025-109"
}
```

ops-bot: Invoice INV-2025-451-R1 created (id inv_9xY) at 2025-07-27T14:42:10Z.

mike_billing: invoice created. next: manual payment allocation. @finance_lead please allocate ch_3K7a9f -> inv_9xY and update ledger. also email PDF to ap@maestro-retail.com and confirm acceptance.

finance_lead: allocated payment ch_3K7a9f to inv_9xY. ledger updated. emailed PDF and confirmation to ap@maestro-retail.com — awaiting AP reconciliation ack. :mailbox_with_mail: 

rachel_support: AP replied — confirmed PO visible and matched. they will reconcile on their side and close the ticket. thanks team. :tada: 

mike_billing: postmortem note: add validation to billing pipeline to require purchase_reference when invoice is sent to corporate AP domains (example maestro-retail.com). filing backlog item.

rachel_support: filed RB-342 for devex to propose small UX change on invoice capture.

jordan_account_manager: keeping thread as audit trail. will close after AP final ack in 24h.
